title: COMP/MCCAA/11/2021: Abandonment of Proposed Acquisition by Lidl Immobiliare Malta Limited of property at Zabbar belonging to Said Investments Limited and leases belonging to Scotts Limited
text:
COMP/MCCAA/11/2021: Abandonment of Proposed Acquisition by Lidl
Immobiliare Malta Limited of property at Zabbar belonging to Said
Investments Limited and leases belonging to Scotts Limited
On the 30 September 2021, a notification of a proposed concentration between
Lidl Immobiliare Malta Limited, Scotts Limited and Said Investments Limited,
was deemed complete by the Office for Competition (hereinafter referred to as
“the Office”).
On 10 November 2021, the Office decided to initiate proceedings for an in-depth
investigation in accordance with regulation 6(1)(iii) of the Control of
Concentrations Regulations (hereinafter referred to as “the regulations”).
Based on statements by the parties to the proposed concentration and evidence
in the file, the concentration, as notified, was considered to have been
abandoned for the purposes of the application of the regulations.
The parties involved are at liberty to file a new notification in the future with the
Office. Any proposed concentration under the regulations, can only be
implemented should the Director General decide not to oppose it and
consequently declare it to be a lawful concentration in terms of the provisions of
the regulations.
The Office is publishing the above statement in accordance with article 19(2) of
the Competition Act.
